standard_prerequisites.name: The notion of an (A, n, c)-module and the compatible system of canonical maps from the pullback of the ideal powers to the structure sheaves of the closed subschemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's section on a bit of uniformity, where the counted statement occurs, and used at the start of the counted proof
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the hypothesis on the module and the maps along which the given homomorphism is pulled back.

standard_prerequisites.name: Duality for the module and the description of maps out of a near-projective module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are cross-chapter pointers invoked inside the counted proof
standard_prerequisites.use: Convert the pullback of the given map into a map of dual modules, which is where the shift in the ideal power comes from.

core_obligations: Pull back along the canonical maps: the proof recalls the compatible system of maps from the pullback of the ideal powers to the structure sheaves of the closed subschemes, uses it to pull the given homomorphism back, and obtains a map landing in the structure sheaf of the closed subscheme determined by the exponent (proof lines 5344-5352)
Pass to the dual: by duality this map corresponds to a section of a dual module whose annihilator properties are known from the companion statements (proof lines 5352-5430)

Produce the factorisation: the proof exhibits elements of the ideal power and maps witnessing the stated factorisation of the composition, in the case where the dimension parameter exceeds one (proof lines 5430-5442)

The remaining cases: for the smaller dimension cases the same argument runs with adjusted constants, and the author states that the case of the parameter equal to zero is exactly the same as the case of the parameter equal to one (proof lines 5442-5448)
proof_roadmap: 用 p^*(I^q) → O_X(q) 的相容系统把给定映射 φ 拉回，得到 χ: p^*M → O_{Y_n}(n)。
转对偶后落在某个对偶模上（其消没性质由本线其他卡/被引结果给出），由此构造出用 I^c 中元素与适当的 ψ_i 分解复合映射的表达式；d = 0 情形与 d = 1 相同。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is a factorisation statement for maps from a uniformly annihilated module into a quotient of ideal powers (author lemma at source lines 5330-5342, label lemma-factor-hom): under an explicit numerical hypothesis on the exponent, the composition of the given map with a shift map factors through elements of a power of the ideal. The proof (source lines 5344-5448) pulls the map back along the canonical system of maps to the closed subschemes, passes to duals where the required annihilation is available, and then exhibits the factorisation with explicit constants; the remaining dimension cases are stated by the author to run identically (proof lines 5442-5448). The pullback-and-dualise step together with the constant bookkeeping is the content. H2.
